risks.proof: Close-up of the base and a wider full-body shot showing wear, patches, or repairs

risks.risk: Unknown if tank holds water without leaking (no cracks visible but not fully shown)
risks.proof: A video or photo of the tank filled with water, or a close inspection of the full exterior including base
risks.if_unproven: priced as not verified leak-free, i.e. functional status unproven

risks.proof: A photo of this specific horizontal tank showing the Storex branding to confirm it is the same unit
risks.if_unproven: treated as unverifiable, not counted toward the item being sold

proof_requests: Clear photo of the capacity/liter marking on the tank (usually near the inlet cap or embossed on the side)
Full-body photo from a few steps back showing the entire tank including the base
Photo or short video of the tank filled with water or being tested for leaks
Confirmation that the tank in photo 1 is the same unit being sold, with a shot showing its Storex branding
